title: Alok Madan
description: Photographs of cities, weather, movement, and the space between.
intro: Cities, weather, and the light that follows you home.
introDesktop: I keep returning to cities at the hour when they become difficult to read. Weather changes the surface. People cross. Light makes a claim, then leaves.
introMobile: Cities, weather, and the light that follows you home.
contactBio: Alok Madan photographs cities as they are lived: through weather, transit, storefronts, monuments, and the people moving between them. The work begins with attention—what light reveals, what motion hides, and what remains after leaving.
contactRepresented: Based in New York. Available for editorial, cultural, and travel commissions, image licensing, and long-form collaborations.
